constraint.description: java.util.Random and Math.random are predictable: use SecureRandom for anything security relevant, ThreadLocalRandom otherwise.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(rt:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND ((rt.fqn = 'java.util.Random' AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = '<init>') OR (rt.fqn = 'java.lang.Math' AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'random')) RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, rt.fqn + '#' + coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) AS Detail

constraint.description: Reading the system clock / default zone directly makes code untestable: inject a java.time.Clock.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(rt:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND ((rt.fqn IN ['java.time.Instant','java.time.LocalDate','java.time.LocalDateTime','java.time.ZonedDateTime','java.time.OffsetDateTime','java.time.LocalTime'] AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'now' AND c.signature ENDS WITH ' now()') OR (rt.fqn = 'java.time.ZoneId' AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'systemDefault')) RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, rt.fqn + '#' + coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) AS Detail

constraint.description: Throwing java.lang.RuntimeException directly hides the failure cause: throw a dedicated exception type.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(rt:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND (rt.fqn = 'java.lang.RuntimeException' AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = '<init>') RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, rt.fqn + '#' + coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) AS Detail

constraint.description: Optional.orElseThrow() without argument throws an anonymous NoSuchElementException: supply a meaningful exception.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (t:Type)-[:DECLARES]->(m:Method)-[:INVOKES]->(c:Method)<-[:DECLARES]-(rt:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND (rt.fqn = 'java.util.Optional' AND coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) = 'orElseThrow' AND c.signature ENDS WITH ' orElseThrow()') RETURN DISTINCT m AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, rt.fqn + '#' + coalesce(c.name, last(split(split(c.signature, '(')[0], ' '))) AS Detail

constraint.description: Classes that nothing depends on and that are not discovered by a framework annotation are candidates for removal.
Temporary / diagnostic code (parameter temporaryCodeRegex) must not ship to production.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND t.fqn =~ $temporaryCodeRegex RETURN DISTINCT t AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'temporary or diagnostic type' AS Detail

constraint.description: Two classes with the same simple name in different packages are a confusion and merge-error source: rename one.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Class) WHERE NOT t:Test AND NOT t.name CONTAINS '$' AND NOT t.name IN ['package-info', 'module-info'] WITH t.name AS name, collect(DISTINCT t) AS types WHERE size(types) > 1 UNWIND types AS t RETURN t AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'simple name ' + name + ' declared ' + toString(size(types)) + ' times' AS Detail

constraint.description: Types whose fully qualified name matches the parameter forbiddenNameRegex (legacy technology names) must be renamed or removed.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (:Artifact)-[:CONTAINS]->(t:Type) WHERE NOT t:Test AND t.fqn =~ $forbiddenNameRegex RETURN DISTINCT t AS Element, t.fqn AS Fqn, 'forbidden naming token' AS Detail
